newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to sell GAN, keep Thomson Multimedia.
newsitem.headline: France to sell GAN, keep Thomson Multimedia.

text.p: France's Socialist-led government plans to privatise insurer GAN and its banking arm CIC but will maintain Thomson Multimedia as a state-owned company, a finance ministry spokeswoman said on Friday.
The announcement followed the government's signal earlier in the day that it was prepared to sell a minority stake in France Telecom.
"In discussions which took place with the European Commission, commitments were taken leading to the privatisation of CIC and GAN," the spokeswoman said, reading from a finance ministry statement.
"The government has decided not to put into doubt these commitments under which it will determine the means of limiting the cost of the state's intervention," the statement said.

The sale of GAN and CIC, planned by the previous centre-right government, had long been expected despite the new government's anti-privatisation stand during the recent election campaign which brought it to power.

Last week, the government cancelled plans by its predecessors to privatise defence electronics firm Thomson-CSF but has since indicated it could lower its current 58 percent stake to below 50 percent.
